headline: Conagra Brands Provides Senior Leadership Update
summary: Conagra Brands, Inc. (NYSE: CAG) today announced changes which will streamline the Company's structure. Noelle O'Mara, executive vice president and president of Refrigerated and Frozen and Jill Dexter, executive vice president and president of Grocery and Snacks, will report directly to president and chief executive officer John Brase.
